reviews.comment: Dr. Hunter is a very good professor. He is fair and strives to push his students. He is incredibly accessible but he struggles to make sure everyone gets quality critiques because the studio sizes are increasing to unmanageable levels but this would be fixed by hiring more faculty. He's got years of field experience. First arch prof to use canvas.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Clear grading criteria, super organized, super knowledgeable in architecture, very very caring about students and their success in his class. Best studio professor I've had in 3 years at TAMU. (He leans more on the practical side of design—not theoretical) Show up, do your work, and listen to his feedback and you will do great. Love this guy!!

Hunter is a sophomore level studio professor and his projects are very technical which is odd this early in the architecture game. Usually at this point, classes are still very conceptual so this class was tough for me. Only does one project for the semester so you have to do great on it to get the A. Not a very valuable studio experience.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria
